title: Nightly Roasted Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Moroccan dish featuring tender lamb in a silky sauce, perfect for a midnight craving. This recipe is halal-friendly and serves 4-6 people.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the white wine vinegar, dried apricots, prunes, cumin, paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cover the tagine or Dutch oven and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until it is tender and the sauce is silky and slightly thickened.
Remove the tagine or Dutch oven from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the lamb and sauce hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
